day_shape: UK attributes RAF Fairford plot to IRGC with 29-nation joint statement, Rubio-Miliband call on Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO reports tanker struck in Hormuz, Houthi missile hits Riyadh's King Khalid airport, Hezbollah cluster submunition kills teen on northern Israel school hike.

threads.label: UK attributes RAF Fairford plot to IRGC
threads.summary: The UK Foreign Secretary blamed Iran's IRGC for an "almost certainly" directed plot targeting RAF Fairford, sanctioned two Iranian nationals and summoned Iran's ambassador, with 29 foreign ministers issuing a joint condemnation. Iran's Foreign Ministry denied involvement and called the accusations baseless; Rubio and Miliband discussed the matter by phone.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz shipping and oil
threads.summary: UKMTO reported a products tanker struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, and Rubio and Miliband reiterated commitment to safeguarding transit. IRIB claimed Brent physical prices reached $154 and the IRGC Navy commander accused the US of acting as a "fuel smuggler" to push tankers through the strait.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Saudi airports
threads.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree announced a ballistic missile attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and a drone strike on Khamis Mushayt; Jerusalem Post said 12 were killed and 309 injured across Riyadh and Abha strikes. The WSJ reported Saudi Arabia running low on interceptors, Pakistan pledged support, and Iran offered to mediate between Riyadh and the Houthis.

threads.label: Northern Israel cluster submunition blast
threads.summary: A teenager was killed and roughly 24 schoolchildren and teachers wounded by an explosion on a school hike at the Ramim Ridge; the IDF said the ordnance was likely a Hezbollah cluster submunition from a Grad rocket. Chief of Staff Zamir ordered an investigation, Netanyahu met victims, and the IDF launched an interceptor at a suspicious aerial target over southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Iran extraterritorial threats and disinformation
threads.summary: A London court heard that a suspect in a plot against Iran International journalists discussed an embassy visit and was promised £150,000; Jerusalem Post reported Iran used AI to seed disinformation articles targeting the US and Israel. Iran also reportedly struck a Kurdish opposition camp in Iraq's Kurdistan Region.

threads.label: Iran internal security and south-east clashes
threads.summary: HRANA reported at least 94 killed and 33 wounded in southeast Iran since March 31 as clashes intensified with heavier weapons. Defa Press reported the execution of a Jundallah member, and the parliament's National Security Commission chief described a "hybrid war" by counter-revolutionary forces in the southeast.

threads.label: Khamenei Law Enforcement Week messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published tree diagrams and summaries of the Supreme Commander's message for Police (Faraja) Week on 16 Mehr. Defa Press and IRIB carried parallel IRGC Navy Day messaging from General Vahidi asserting no extra-regional power had the right to interfere in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Palestinian media reports two dead and three wounded in an Israeli strike in the southern Gaza Strip this morning, with the military saying it struck terror operatives. The strike hit a "security point" near a mosque in the Rafah area, killing Izz al-Din Iyad Diab Barhoum, 22, and Salah al-Din Iyad Abdul Hamid Aql, 29, according to Palestinian media. The IDF tells the Times of Israel that it struck terror operatives in southern Gaza, and the results of the attack are under review.
